prompts.title: Explain Code Like I'm Five
prompts.content:
Explain the following code as if you were teaching a complete beginner. Break down what each part does in plain language, avoid jargon, and use an analogy if it helps:

{code}
prompts.description: Get a beginner-friendly walkthrough of any code snippet.

prompts.title: Optimize SQL Query
prompts.content:
Review the following SQL query and suggest optimizations for performance, indexing, and readability. Explain the reasoning behind each change:

{query}
prompts.description: Analyze and improve a slow or messy SQL query.

prompts.title: Weekly Marketing Email
prompts.content: Write a warm, conversational weekly newsletter email for {product}. Highlight one key update, include a clear call to action, and keep it under 200 words.
prompts.description: Draft a short, friendly newsletter email in minutes.

prompts.title: Resume Bullet Rewriter
prompts.content:
Rewrite the following resume bullet points to be more results-driven, using strong action verbs and quantifiable outcomes where possible:

{bullets}
prompts.description: Turn flat resume bullets into achievement-focused lines.

prompts.title: Write a Professional Email
prompts.content: Write a professional email to {recipient} about {topic}. Keep the tone polite and concise, include a clear subject line, and end with an appropriate call to action.
prompts.description: Draft a polite, professional email for any workplace situation
